title: Tech Note: Displaying and Hiding Tool Features Inside Plug-in Areas
featured_technology: 4D productivity plug-in interface elements (menu bar, toolbars, scrollbars)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents how to manually and procedurally show/hide interface chrome (menus, toolbars, scrollbars) within 4D's classic productivity plug-in areas — 4D Chart, 4D Draw, 4D Write, and 4D View — useful for read-only display scenarios. All four of these companion products have since been superseded by later-generation 4D technologies (notably 4D Write Pro in 2016 and 4D View Pro in 2018), so the specific plug-in area commands described are obsolete, though the general UI concept of controlling embedded-tool chrome visibility for read-only contexts remains a recognizable pattern in current 4D Write Pro/View Pro areas.
related_updates: 4D Write was superseded by 4D Write Pro (introduced 2016)
4D View was superseded by 4D View Pro (introduced 2018)
4D Chart and 4D Draw as standalone productivity plug-ins are legacy technology largely absent from current 4D releases
